Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error happened when WebSurfer used IMDb’s advanced search but only surfaced the top visible results and did not fully verify the actual highest-rated qualifying feature film under 2 hours. More importantly, the later conclusion “The Tenant” was accepted as the final answer without confirming that it was the highest-rated Isabelle Adjani feature film meeting all constraints and available on Vudu/Fandango at Home. The reasoning chain appears to have been derailed by relying on incomplete search-result snippets and not establishing a valid, fully verified availability check for the target film.
